closedShown.label: Closed stages shown
closedShown.help: Stages closed until the owner says so (S15 AI control room, S17 multi-store, S23 social studio, S24 virtual photoshoot, S25 video campaign, S26, S27 handover pack). Off (the default) hides every half-built part of the stage from the admin menu, the admin search, the sitemap, the shop search and robots. Turn a stage on only when it is finished. Nothing is deleted.
